summary: Hash full outbound ticket content before receipt deduplication

delivery.outcome: Publish long-description edits through Planfile without mistaking a shared prefix for an already synchronized payload; PLF-086 / GitHub174
nonGoals: No changes to other active tickets, credentials, publication policy or dependencies.

architecture.decision: Hash complete normalized outbound fields; retain bounded intent previews and digest-only durable receipts. Existing mappings route migration to updates, never duplicate issues.
architecture.rollback: Revert the bounded follow-up commit through protected publication.

validation.evidence: Regression fails before fix and passes after; exact-head protected verification before merge.
